sensor_query.query: Option Explicit checkTaniumBinaries() Dim objWMIService,colItems Dim strSep Dim objItem,bHashDlls Dim bHasHashedFile,bHashExes,strHashType,intMaxRows,intRowCount strHashType = LCase(Trim(UTF8Decode("SHA256"))) If strHashType <> "md5" and strHashType <> "sha1" and strHashType <> "sha256" Then WScript.Echo GetInvalidHashSelectedStr() WScript.Quit End If strSep = "|" bHashDlls = True bHashExes = False intMaxRows = 200 Dim objFSO: Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") Dim dictFilesToHash: Set dictFilesToHash = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set objWMIService = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2") Set colItems = objWMIService.ExecQuery("Select * from Win32_Process",,48) bHasHashedFile = False If bHashExes Then For Each objItem in colItems If Not IsNull(objItem.ExecutablePath) Then Call AddToDictCaseInsensitive(dictFilesToHash, objItem.ExecutablePath, 1) End If Next End If If bHashDlls Then AddDllsToList(dictFilesToHash) End If Dim item Dim tfi: Set tfi = (new TaniumFileAttrs)("default") if strHashType = "md5" Then tfi.AddColumn(tfi.Column_MD5) elseif strHashType = "sha1" Then tfi.AddColumn(tfi.Column_SHA1) else tfi.AddColumn(tfi.Column_SHA256) End If For Each item In dictFilesToHash tfi.AddFile(item) Next Dim exitCode: exitCode = tfi.Execute() Dim stdlib: Set stdlib = (new StandardLib)(Null, Null, Null, Null, Null) If exitCode = stdlib.Err_Timeout Then Wscript.Echo "Sensor exited because its timeout was reached" Wscript.Quit ElseIf exitCode <> 0 Then Wscript.Echo "Failed to calculate hash" Wscript.Quit End If intRowCount = 0 Dim name: For Each name in tfi.Results Dim key: For Each key in tfi.Results(name).Keys Dim colName: For Each colName in tfi.Results(name)(key) Dim strHash If Len(tfi.Results(name)(key)(colName)) >= 32 Then strHash = tfi.Results(name)(key)(colName) Else strHash = "Unable to Hash File" End If WScript.Echo UTF8Decode(name & strSep & strHash) intRowCount = intRowCount + 1 if intRowCount > intMaxRows Then WScript.Echo "Maximum rows exceeded." WScript.Quit End If Next Next Next Set objFSO = Nothing WScript.Quit '------------ INCLUDES below ----- Const PID="PID", EXECUTABLE="EXECUTABLE", CMDLINE = "CMDLINE", DLLS="DLLS" Function AddDllsToDict() Dim objFSO, objShell, strListdllsPath Dim arrLines, dictProcesses, execResults Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") If OlderThanXP() Then Wscript.Echo GetIncompatibleUtilsStr() Wscript.Quit End If strListDllsPath = GetTaniumDir1Arg("Tools\IR") & "TanListModules.exe" Dim strExecPath: strExecPath= GetTaniumDir1Arg("Tools\IR") & "TaniumExecWrapper.exe" If Not objFSO.FileExists(strListDllsPath) Then WScript.Echo GetIrToolsNotInstalledStr() WScript.Quit End If Set execResults = TaniumExec(Chr(34) & strListDllsPath & Chr(34), False, "", "", "", "") arrLines = Split(execResults.StdOut.ReadAll, vbCrLf) Set dictProcesses = ProcessListDLLOutputAllDlls(arrLines) Set AddDllsToDict = dictProcesses End Function Function AddDllsToList(dictFilesToHash) Dim dictProcesses, strPid, dictProcess, dictDlls, strDll Set dictProcesses = AddDllsToDict() For Each strPid In dictProcesses.Keys Set dictProcess = dictProcesses.Item(strPid) Set dictDlls = dictProcess.Item("DLLS") For Each strDll In dictDlls.Keys Call AddToDictCaseInsensitive(dictFilesToHash, strDll, 1) Next Next End Function Function AddToDictCaseInsensitive(dict, key, value) Dim k, found: found = False For Each k in dict If LCase(k) = LCase(key) Then found = True End If Next If Not found Then Call dict.Add(key, value) End If End Function Function ProcessListDLL2OutputAllDlls(arrLines) Dim strLine, dictResult, bInProcessDesc, dictProcess, dictDlls, arrSplitStr Set dictResult = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set dictProcess = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set dictDlls = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") bInProcessDesc = False For Each strLine In arrLines strLine = Replace(Trim(strLine), vbCr, "") If(bInProcessDesc) Then If(InStr(strLine, " pid: ")) Then Dim strExe, strPid arrSplitStr = Split(strLine, " ") strExe = arrSplitStr(0) strPid = arrSplitStr(2) dictProcess.Add EXECUTABLE, strExe dictProcess.Add PID, strPid dictProcess.Add DLLS, dictDlls dictResult.Add strPid, dictProcess ElseIf(Left(strLine, 14) = "Command line: ") Then Dim strCmdLine strCmdLine = Right(strLine, Len(strLine) - 14) dictProcess.Add CMDLINE, strCmdLine ElseIf(Left(strLine, 2) = "0x") Then Dim strDll, i, x arrSplitStr = Split(strLine, " ") For i=0 To UBound(arrSplitStr) If Not IsNumeric(Left(arrSplitStr(i), 1)) And arrSplitStr(i) <> "" Then x = i Exit For End If Next strDll = arrSplitStr(x) For i=(x+1) To UBound(arrSplitStr) strDll = strDll & " " & arrSplitStr(i) Next Call AddToDictCaseInsensitive(dictDlls, strDll, True) End If If(InStr(strLine, "-----------------")) Then Set dictProcess = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set dictDlls = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End If Else If(InStr(strLine, "-----------------")) Then bInProcessDesc = True End If End if Next Set ProcessListDLL2OutputAllDlls = dictResult End Function Function ProcessListDLLOutputAllDlls(arrLines) Dim strLine, dictResult, bInProcessDesc, dictProcess, dictDlls, arrSplitStr Set dictResult = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set dictProcess = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set dictDlls = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") bInProcessDesc = False For Each strLine In arrLines strLine = Replace(Trim(strLine), vbCr, "") If(bInProcessDesc) Then If(InStr(strLine, " pid: ")) Then Dim strExe, strPid arrSplitStr = Split(strLine, " ") strExe = arrSplitStr(0) strPid = arrSplitStr(2) dictProcess.Add EXECUTABLE, strExe dictProcess.Add PID, strPid dictProcess.Add DLLS, dictDlls dictResult.Add strPid, dictProcess ElseIf(Left(strLine, 14) = "Command line: ") Then Dim strCmdLine strCmdLine = Right(strLine, Len(strLine) - 14) dictProcess.Add CMDLINE, strCmdLine ElseIf(Left(strLine, 2) = "0x") Then Dim strDll, i, x arrSplitStr = Split(strLine, " ") For i=0 To UBound(arrSplitStr) If Not (Left(arrSplitStr(i), 2) = "0x") And arrSplitStr(i) <> "" Then x = i Exit For End If Next strDll = arrSplitStr(x) For i=(x+1) To UBound(arrSplitStr) strDll = strDll & " " & arrSplitStr(i) Next Call AddToDictCaseInsensitive(dictDlls, strDll, True) End If If(InStr(strLine, "-----------------")) Then Set dictProcess = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Set dictDlls = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End If Else If(InStr(strLine, "-----------------")) Then bInProcessDesc = True End If End if Next Set ProcessListDLLOutputAllDlls = dictResult End Function Function IsLegacyOS Dim majorVersion, result majorVersion = GetOSMajorVersion If Left(majorVersion,1) = 5 Then result = True Else result = False End If IsLegacyOS = result End Function Function OlderThanXP() OlderThanXP = False If Safe_CDbl(GetOSMajorVersion()) <= 5.0 Then OlderThanXP = True End If End Function Function GetTaniumDir1Arg(strSubDir) Dim strResult strResult = GetClientDir() If strSubDir <> "" Then strResult = strResult & strSubDir GenFolderPath strResult, Null strResult = strResult & "\" End If GetTaniumDir1Arg = strResult End Function Function GetClientDir() Dim strResult strResult = GetEnvironmentValue("TANIUM_CLIENT_ROOT") If IsNull(strResult) Then Dim objSh strResult = "" Set objSh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") On Error Resume Next If strResult="" Then strResult=Eval("objSh.RegRead(""HKLM\Software\Tanium\Tanium Client\Path"")") : Err.Clear If strResult="" Then strResult=Eval("objSh.RegRead(""HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Tanium\Tanium Client\Path"")") : Err.Clear If strResult="" Then Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 End If If strResult="" Then Call fRaiseError(5, "GetClientDir", _ "TSE-Error:Can not locate client directory", False) If Right(strResult, 1) <> "\" Then strResult = strResult & "\" GetClientDir = strResult End Function Function fRaiseError(errCode, errSource, errorMsg, RaiseError) If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(errCode, errSource, errorMsg) Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End Function Function GetEnvironmentValue(strName) Dim objShell, strSub, strResult Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") strSub = "%" & strName & "%" strResult = objShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strSub) If strResult = strSub Then GetEnvironmentValue = Null Else GetEnvironmentValue = strResult End If End Function Function GenFolderPath(fPath, fso) GenFolderPath = False If IsNull(fso) Then Set fso = WScript.CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject") End If If Not fso.FolderExists(fPath) Then If GenFolderPath(fso.GetParentFolderName(fPath), fso) Then GenFolderPath = True Call fso.CreateFolder(fPath) End If Else GenFolderPath = True End If End Function Function GetIrToolsNotInstalledStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetIrToolsNotInstalledStr = "TSE-Error: Required utilities not found; ensure tools are installed" End Function Function GetBadMd5HashLengthStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetBadMd5HashLengthStr = "TSE-Error: Incorrect MD5 Hash Value Length" End Function Function GetBadSha1HashLengthStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetBadSha1HashLengthStr = "TSE-Error: Incorrect SHA1 Hash Value Length" End Function Function GetBadSha256HashLengthStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetBadSha256HashLengthStr = "TSE-Error: Incorrect SHA256 Hash Length" End Function Function GetIncompatibleUtilsStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetIncompatibleUtilsStr = "Cannot run on operating system due to incompatibility with required utilities" End Function Function GetUnsupportedOsStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetUnsupportedOsStr = "Unsupported legacy operating system (XP/2003). Exiting." End Function Function GetInvalidHashSelectedStr '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK GetInvalidHashSelectedStr = "Invalid Hash Type selected" End Function Function TaniumExec(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 Dim strCommand: strCommand = TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) Set TaniumExec = (new MockWshScriptExec)(strCommand) If TaniumExec.ExitCode = 3 Then Dim errorMsg: errorMsg = "Timeout limit of " & Timeout & " second(s) reached and the process was killed: " & strCommand If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(6, "TaniumExec", errorMsg) Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End If End Function Function TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) Dim objFSO: Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") If ExePath = "" Then ExePath = GetTaniumDir1Arg("Tools\IR") & "TaniumExecWrapper.exe" If Not objFSO.FileExists(ExePath) Then Call fRaiseError(53, "TExecHelper", GetIrToolsNotInstalledStr & ". Missing: " & ExePath, RaiseError) End If If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 If LogLevel = "" Then LogLevel = "error" Dim strCommand strCommand = Chr(34) & ExePath & Chr(34) strCommand = strCommand & " --timeout " & Timeout strCommand = strCommand & " --loglevel " & LogLevel Dim valid: valid = False If TypeName(RedirectOutput) = "String" Then If Not RedirectOutput = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput & Chr(34) valid = True ElseIf TypeName(RedirectOutput) = TypeName(Array()) Then If UBound(RedirectOutput) = 1 Then If Not RedirectOutput(0) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput(0) & Chr(34) If Not RedirectOutput(1) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stderr-to """ & RedirectOutput(1) & Chr(34) valid = True End If ElseIf RedirectOutput = False Then valid = True End If If Not valid Then Call fRaiseError(5, "TExecHelper", _ "RedirectOutput argument to TExecHelper must be a String or a Length-2 Array.", RaiseError) End If strCommand = strCommand & " -- " & Command_ TExecHelper = strCommand End Function Function fRaiseError(errCode, errSource, errorMsg, RaiseError) If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(errCode, errSource, errorMsg) Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End Function Class MockTextStream Private text Private stream_read Public Default Function Init(stream_content) Set Init = Me text = stream_content stream_read = False End Function Public Property Get ReadAll If Not stream_read Then ReadAll = text stream_read = True Else ReadAll = "" End If End Property End Class Class MockWshScriptExec Private stdout_: Public Property Get StdOut : Set StdOut = stdout_ : End Property Private stderr_: Public Property Get StdErr : Set StdErr = stderr_ : End Property Private exitcode_: Public Property Get ExitCode : ExitCode = exitcode_ : End Property Public Default Function Init(strCommand) Set Init = Me Dim objShell: Set objShell = CreateObject("Wscript.Shell") Dim realWshScriptExec: Set realWshScriptExec = objShell.Exec(strCommand) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK Set stdout_ = (new MockTextStream)(realWshScriptExec.StdOut.ReadAll()) Set stderr_ = (new MockTextStream)(realWshScriptExec.StdErr.ReadAll()) exitcode_ = realWshScriptExec.ExitCode End Function End Class Function Is64 Dim objWMIService, colItems, objItem Set objWMIService = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\CIMV2") Set colItems = objWMIService.ExecQuery("Select SystemType from Win32_ComputerSystem") For Each objItem In colItems If InStr(LCase(objItem.SystemType), "x64") > 0 Then Is64 = True Else Is64 = False End If Next End Function Function GetOSMajorVersion Dim strVersion,arrVersion strVersion = GetOSVersion() arrVersion = Split(strVersion,".") If UBound(arrVersion) >= 1 Then strVersion = arrVersion(0)&"."&arrVersion(1) End If GetOSMajorVersion = strVersion End Function Function GetOSVersion Dim objWMIService,colItems,objItem Dim strVersion strVersion = Null Set objWMIService = GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\CIMV2") Set colItems = GetObject("WinMgmts:root/cimv2").ExecQuery("select Version from win32_operatingsystem") For Each objItem In colItems strVersion = objItem.Version Next If IsNull(strVersion) Then fRaiseError 5, "GetOSVersion", "Error: Can not determine OS Version", False End If GetOSVersion = strVersion End Function Function Safe_CDBl(value) Dim intOldLocale: intOldLocale = GetLocale() SetLocale(1033) Safe_CDBl = CDbl(value) SetLocale(intOldLocale) End Function Function Safe_CSng(value) Dim intOldLocale: intOldLocale = GetLocale() SetLocale(1033) Safe_CSng = CSng(value) SetLocale(intOldLocale) End Function Function checkTaniumBinaries() If (Not fileCheckPassed(GetTaniumDir1Arg("Tools\IR") & "TanFileInfo.exe", _ "TanFileInfo.exe", "3.9.30.0", False)) Then WScript.Echo "Please redeploy tools to this endpoint." WScript.Quit() End If End Function Function fileCheckPassed(filePath, fileShortName, desiredVersionStr, printOnSuccess) fileCheckPassed = True Dim objFSO: Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject") If Not objFSO.FileExists(filePath) Then WScript.Echo "Missing " & fileShortName fileCheckPassed = False Exit Function End If If desiredVersionStr <> "no_version_check" Then On Error Resume Next Dim strVersion: strVersion = LCase(objFSO.GetFileVersion(filePath)) If Err.Number <> 0 Then strVersion = "Indeterminate" Err.Clear End If On Error Goto 0 If strVersion <> desiredVersionStr Then WScript.Echo fileShortName & " version: " & strVersion & ", needs: " & desiredVersionStr fileCheckPassed = False Else If printOnSuccess Then WScript.Echo fileShortName & " version: " & strVersion End If End If End If End Function Class TaniumFileAttrs Public Property Get TaniumIndex_Require: TaniumIndex_Require="require": End Property Public Property Get TaniumIndex_Optional: TaniumIndex_Optional="optional": End Property Public Property Get TaniumIndex_Omit: TaniumIndex_Omit="omit": End Property Public Property Get Column_MD5: Column_MD5="md5": End Property Public Property Get Column_SHA1: Column_SHA1="sha1": End Property Public Property Get Column_SHA256: Column_SHA256="sha256": End Property Public Property Get Column_SIZE: Column_SIZE="size": End Property Public Property Get Column_PETYPE: Column_PETYPE="petype": End Property Public Property Get Column_SIGNED: Column_SIGNED="signed": End Property Public TaniumIndex Public TimeoutSecs Public ExitCode Public Results Private Columns_() Private ExePath_ Private Delim Private InputFiles_ Private stdLib_ Private Mode_ Public Default Function Init(exePath) Set Init=Me Dim objFso: Set objFso = WScript.CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject") If exePath = "default" Then ExePath_ = GetTaniumDir1Arg("Tools\IR") & "TanFileInfo.exe" If Not objFso.FileExists(ExePath_) Then ExePath_ = GetTaniumDir1Arg("Tools\IR") & "TaniumFileInfo.exe" End If Else ExePath_=exePath End If If Not objFso.FileExists(ExePath_) Then WScript.Echo GetIrToolsNotInstalledStr() WScript.Quit End If TaniumIndex="omit" Delim="|" TimeoutSecs=45 Mode_="attrs" ExitCode=Empty Set InputFiles_=CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") ReDim Columns_(0) End Function Public Sub AddColumn(col) ReDim Preserve Columns_(UBound(Columns_) + 1) Columns_(UBound(Columns_) - 1) = col End Sub Public Sub AddFile(f) If Not InputFiles_.Exists(f) Then InputFiles_.Add f, 0 End Sub Public Function Execute() Set stdLib_ = (new StandardLib)(ExePath_, Mode_, TaniumIndex, Delim, TimeoutSecs) Execute = stdLib_.Execute(Columns_, InputFiles_) Set Results = stdLib_.Results End Function End Class Class StandardLib Public Property Get Err_General: Err_General=1: End Property Public Property Get Err_Assert: Err_Assert=2: End Property Public Property Get Err_Timeout: Err_Timeout=10: End Property Public Property Get Err_Index: Err_Index=11: End Property Public TaniumIndex_ Public Delim_ Public TimeoutSecs_ Public Mode_ Public ExePath_ Public ExitCode Public Results Public Default Function Init(ExePath, Mode, TaniumIndex, Delim, TimeoutSecs) Set Init=Me TaniumIndex_ = TaniumIndex Mode_ = Mode Delim_ = Delim TimeoutSecs_ = TimeoutSecs ExePath_ = ExePath Set Results=CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End Function Public Function CmdLine(Columns) CmdLine = "" & Mode_ If Delim_<>"" Then CmdLine = CmdLine & " --delim """ & Delim_ & """" If TimeoutSecs_<>0 Then CmdLine = CmdLine & " --timeout " & TimeoutSecs_ Dim c: For c=0 to UBound(Columns) - 1 Dim col: col=Columns(c) CmdLine = CmdLine & " --column " & col Next End Function Public Function Execute(Columns, InputFiles) Dim shObj: Set shObj=CreateObject("WScript.Shell") Dim cmd: cmd = """" & ExePath_ & """ --input-url-encoded --output-url-encoded " & CmdLine(Columns) & " -" Dim objExec: Set objExec = shObj.Exec(cmd) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK Dim inFile: For Each inFile in InputFiles.Keys objExec.StdIn.WriteLine(UTF8Encode(inFile)) Next objExec.StdIn.Close ExitCode = objExec.ExitCode ' Ignore stderr (it's just logging and is empty unless we specify --loglevel) If ExitCode = 0 Or ExitCode = Err_Timeout Then Call ParseResults(objExec.StdOut, Columns) End If Execute = ExitCode End Function Sub ParseResults(stream, Columns) Dim expected: expected=UBound(Columns) Dim count: count = 0 Do While Not stream.AtEndOfStream Dim arrlines: arrlines=Split(stream.ReadLine(), vbCrLf) Dim i: For i = LBound(arrlines) to UBound(arrLines) If arrlines(i) = "Timeout reached" Then Wscript.Echo "Sensor exited because its timeout was reached" Wscript.Quit End If Dim tokens: tokens = Split(arrlines(i), Delim_) If UBound(tokens) = 0 Then Results.Add tokens(0), CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Results(tokens(0)).Add count, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Else If UBound(tokens)<>expected Then Err.Raise 1, "", "Unexpected number of tokens in result. Expected=" & expected & " got=" & UBound(tokens) If Not Replace(tokens(0), " ", "") = "" Then count = 0 Dim fPath: fPath = tokens(0) Results.Add fPath, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") End If Results(fPath).Add count, CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary") Dim r: For r=1 to UBound(tokens) Dim colName: colName=Columns(r-1) Results(fPath).Item(count).Add colName, tokens(r) Next count = count + 1 End If Next Loop End Sub End Class Function UTF8Encode(ByVal rawStr) Dim firstStream: Set firstStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream") firstStream.Type = 2 firstStream.Charset = "utf-8" firstStream.Open firstStream.Position = 0 firstStream.WriteText rawStr firstStream.Position = 3 Dim secondStream: Set secondStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream") secondStream.Type = 1 secondStream.Mode = 3 secondStream.Open firstStream.CopyTo secondStream firstStream.Flush firstStream.Close secondStream.Position = 0 Dim byteArray: byteArray = secondStream.Read() secondStream.Flush secondStream.Close Dim encodedStr: encodedStr = "" Dim binaryStr: binaryStr = CStr(byteArray) Dim i: For i = 1 To UBound(byteArray) + 1 encodedStr = encodedStr & "%" & Hex(AscB(MidB(binaryStr, i, 1))) Next UTF8Encode = encodedStr End Function Function UTF8Decode(str) Dim arraylist(), strLen, i, sT, val, depth, sR Dim arraysize arraysize = 0 strLen = Len(str) for i = 1 to strLen sT = mid(str, i, 1) if sT = "%" then if i + 2 <= strLen then Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = cbyte("&H" & mid(str, i + 1, 2)) arraysize = arraysize + 1 i = i + 2 end if else Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = asc(sT) arraysize = arraysize + 1 end if next depth = 0 for i = 0 to arraysize - 1 Dim mybyte mybyte = arraylist(i) if mybyte and &h80 then if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then if depth = 0 then Err.Raise 5 end if val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f) depth = depth - 1 if depth = 0 then sR = sR & chrw(val) val = 0 end if elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h1f depth = 1 elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h0f depth = 2 else Err.Raise 5 end if else if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 sR = sR & chrw(mybyte) end if next if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 UTF8Decode = sR End Function

Columns) Dim expected: expected=UBound(Columns) Dim count: count = 0 Do While Not stream.AtEndOfStream Dim arrlines: arrlines=Split(stream.ReadLine(), vbCrLf) Dim i: For i = LBound(arrlines) to 1 Dim mybyte mybyte = arraylist(i) if mybyte and &h80 then if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then if depth = 0 then Err.Raise 5 end if val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f) depth = depth - 1 if depth = 0 then sR = sR & chrw(val) val = 0 end if elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h1f depth = 1 elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h0f depth = 2 else Err.Raise 5 end if else if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 sR = sR & chrw(mybyte) end if next if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 UTF8Decode = sR End Function

Option Explicit
'INCLUDE=utils/settings/GetClientDir.vbs 'INCLUDE=i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/CheckEPIArgSupport.vbs 'INCLUDE=exec/TaniumExec.vbs
Dim strTaniumEpiDir,fso,strExeName,strDestFilePath,objShell,execed,strLimit,strUrlArg,strOptionalArg,strExecWrapper Dim strDirectoryPathIn,strFileNameIn,strSizeIn,strHashIn,strHashSHA1In,strHashSHA256In,strMagicNumberIn,strLimitIn Dim strDirectoryPath,strFileName,strSize,strHash,strHashSHA1,strHashSHA256,strMagicNumber Dim strLookBkHrsIn,strExcludeTCEntries,blnExcludeTCEntries Dim bTreatAsRegex,strTreatAsRegex
strTaniumEpiDir = GetClientDir() & "Tools\EPI\" strExeName = "TaniumEndpointIndex.exe" strExecWrapper = strTaniumEpiDir & "TaniumExecWrapper.exe"
Set fso = WScript.CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject") Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") strDestFilePath = strTaniumEpiDir & strExeName
'default limit strLimit="10"
bTreatAsRegex = False strTreatAsRegex = UTF8Decode("0") If Trim(strTreatAsRegex) = "1" Then bTreatAsRegex = CheckEPIRegexSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath) End If strDirectoryPathIn = UTF8Decode("%2a") strFileNameIn = UTF8Decode("%2a") strSizeIn = UTF8Decode("%2a") strHashIn = UTF8Decode("%2a") strHashSHA1In = UTF8Decode("%2a") strHashSHA256In = UTF8Decode("%2a") strMagicNumberIn = UTF8Decode("4D5A%2a") strLimitIn = UTF8Decode("300") strLookBkHrsIn = UTF8Decode("3") strExcludeTCEntries = UTF8Decode("1")
strDirectoryPath = GenerateValidQueryInput(strDirectoryPathIn,"*") strFileName = GenerateValidQueryInput(strFileNameIn,"*") strSize = GenerateValidQueryInput(strSizeIn,"*") strHash = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashIn,"*") strHashSHA1 = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashSHA1In,"*") strHashSHA256 = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashSHA256In,"*") strMagicNumber = GenerateValidQueryInput(strMagicNumberIn,"*") strLimit = GenerateValidQueryInput(strLimitIn,strLimit)
If Trim(strExcludeTCEntries) = "0" Then blnExcludeTCEntries = false Else blnExcludeTCEntries = true End If
strUrlArg=" --url-encode-output" strOptionalArg="" If CheckEPIArgSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath, strUrlArg)Then strOptionalArg=strUrlArg End If execed=ExeEPI(fso,objShell, strDestFilePath, strDirectoryPath, strFileName, strSize, strHash, strMagicNumber, strLimit, strOptionalArg)
Function UnixDate(dtmDate) ' converts a date value to seconds since Unix epoch UnixDate = DateDiff("s", "01/01/1970 00:00:00", dtmDate) End Function
Function ExeEPI(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath,ByVal strDirectoryPath, ByVal strFileName,ByVal strSize,ByVal strHash,ByVal strMagicNumber,ByVal strLimit,ByVal strOptionalArg) ExeEPI=False If (fso.FileExists(strDestFilePath))Then Dim oExec,strCmd,strOutput,strSelect,strParams,intUnixTimeNow,intUnixTimeStart,intLookBkHrs,strSQLiteOR
intLookBkHrs = -1 intUnixTimeNow = UnixDate(Now)
'convert input string to integer On Error Resume Next intLookBkHrs = CInt(strLookBkHrsIn) On Error Goto 0
If intLookBkHrs < 0 Then WScript.Echo ("Look back hours value is not valid.") WScript.Quit End If
If intLookBkHrs > 168 Then WScript.Echo ("Look back hours exceeds maximum allowed.") WScript.Quit Else intUnixTimeStart = intUnixTimeNow - (intLookBkHrs * 3600) End If
strSQLiteOR = "||" strSelect = "SELECT Path " & strSQLiteOR & "'\'" & strSQLiteOR & "Name, MD5, SHA1, SHA256 FROM vFiles WHERE" strSelect = strSelect & " FileId > 0" Call RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir(strDirectoryPath) If bTreatAsRegex Then ' Special prefix means we'll be using regular expressions, and therefore ' may need the '|' character inside actual parameter values. ' Use double pipes as the separator. strParams="@regex" Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Name",strFileName,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Size",strSize,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"MD5",strHash,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"SHA1",strHashSHA1,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"SHA256",strHashSHA256,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"MagicNumber",strMagicNumber,"||") Call AppendTimeSliceRegex(strSelect,strParams,intUnixTimeStart,"||") Else If IsSpecialDirectoryGlob(strDirectoryPath) Then Call AppendSpecialDirectoryGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath) Else Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath) End If Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Name",strFileName) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Size",strSize) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"MD5",strHash) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"SHA1",strHashSHA1) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"SHA256",strHashSHA256) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"MagicNumber",strMagicNumber) Call AppendTimeSlice(strSelect,strParams,intUnixTimeStart) End If
If blnExcludeTCEntries Then Dim strTCDir: strTCDir = GetClientDir() If Right(strTCDir, 1) = "\" Then strTCDir = Left(strTCDir, Len(strTCDir) - 1) End If strSelect = strSelect & " AND Path NOT LIKE '%"& strTCDir &"%'" End If
strSelect = strSelect & " LIMIT " & strLimit
strCmd=Chr(34)& strDestFilePath &Chr(34)& strOptionalArg & " -psescape " &Chr(34)& "^" &Chr(34)& " -psprep " &Chr(34)& strSelect &Chr(34)& " -psparams " &Chr(34)& strParams &Chr(34)

' This function should be used to safely pass non english input to sensors.
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs
Function UTF8Decode(str) Dim arraylist(), strLen, i, sT, val, depth, sR Dim arraysize arraysize = 0 strLen = Len(str) for i = 1 to strLen sT = mid(str, i, 1) if sT = "%" then if i + 2 <= strLen then Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = cbyte("&H" & mid(str, i + 1, 2)) arraysize = arraysize + 1 i = i + 2 end if else Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = asc(sT) arraysize = arraysize + 1 end if next depth = 0 for i = 0 to arraysize - 1 Dim mybyte mybyte = arraylist(i) if mybyte and &h80 then if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then if depth = 0 then Err.Raise 5 end if val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f) depth = depth - 1 if depth = 0 then sR = sR & chrw(val) val = 0 end if elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h1f depth = 1 elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h0f depth = 2 else Err.Raise 5 end if else if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 sR = sR & chrw(mybyte) end if next if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 UTF8Decode = sR End Function '- End file: i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs '- Begin file: index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs Sub AppendWhereGlob(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal) If (StrComp("*", columnVal) <> 0) Then strSelect = strSelect & " AND " & columnName & " LIKE ?" Sub AppendWhereRegex(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal, ByVal delimVal) If Len(columnVal) > 0 Then If (StrComp("*", columnVal) <> 0) Then If (StrComp(".*", columnVal) <> 0) Then strSelect = strSelect & " AND " & columnName & " REGEXP ?" strParams = strParams + delimVal strParams = strParams + Replace(columnVal, "^", "^^") End If End If End If End Sub
Sub AppendSpecialDirectoryGlob(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal) ' Strip off the trailing "\*" from the columnVal Dim bareDirectoryVal bareDirectoryVal = Left(columnVal, Len(columnVal) - 2) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (" & columnName & " = ? OR " & columnName & " LIKE ?)" If Len(strParams) > 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If ' Add two parameter values, one for 'bare' directory path, and one with ' the trailing "slash-star" wildcard strParams = strParams & bareDirectoryVal & "|" strParams = strParams + GlobToLike(columnVal) End Sub
Sub AppendTimeSlice(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnVal) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" If Len(strParams) <> 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If strParams = strParams + CStr(columnVal) + "|" + CStr(columnVal) End Sub
Sub AppendTimeSliceRegex(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnVal, ByVal delimVal) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" strParams = strParams + delimVal + CStr(columnVal) + delimVal + CStr(columnVal) End Sub
Function IsSpecialDirectoryGlob(ByVal strDirectoryParam) ' Regex search to see if directory parameter is something like ' C:\Users\* ' Where a trailing slash is followed by the star wildcard Dim specialRx Set specialRx = New RegExp specialRx.Global = True specialRx.IgnoreCase = True specialRx.Pattern = "^([A-Z]:\\[^\*\?]+)\\\*$" IsSpecialDirectoryGlob = specialRx.Test(strDirectoryParam) End Function
Function GlobToLike(byVal strGlob) GlobToLike = strGlob GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "^", "^^") GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "*", "^%") GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "?", "_") End Function '- End file: index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs '- Begin file: index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs Function GenerateValidQueryInput(ByVal strIn, ByVal strDefaultValue) If Len(strIn) = 0 Then If Len(strDefaultValue) = 0 Then GenerateValidQueryInput="*" Else GenerateValidQueryInput=strDefaultValue End If Else GenerateValidQueryInput = strIn End If End Function

Function TaniumExec(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) 'Wraps and executes the Command_ via ExePath using Wscript.Shell.Exec(strCommand) ' 'Arguments: ' Command_ (string): Command and arguments to run ' RaiseError (boolean): If True, raise an error when an error is encountered. Otherwise, just print an error message and quit ' Timeout (int): Timeout in seconds (Default = 45) ' LogLevel (string): Log level (Default = "error") ' ExePath (string): Path to wrappper exe use (Default = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe") ' RedirectOutput (String or Array(2)): Path to redirect stdout if a non-empty String, or paths to stdout and stderr if an Array(2) 'Returns: ' Execution results object If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 Dim strCommand: strCommand = TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) Set TaniumExec = (new MockWshScriptExec)(strCommand)
' ExitCode = 10 is encountered when the timeout is reaching, causing TaniumExecWrapper to kill the process If TaniumExec.ExitCode = 10 Then Dim errorMsg: errorMsg = "Timeout limit of " & Timeout & " second(s) reached and the process was killed: " & strCommand If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(6, "TaniumExec", errorMsg) '6 = "Overflow" Error Code Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End If End Function 'TaniumExec '- End file: exec/TaniumExec.vbs '- Begin file: exec/TExecHelper.vbs
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/TExecHelper.vbs
Function TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) 'Builds a command string intended to be executed via Wscript.Shell.Exec or Wscript.Shell.Run ' 'Arguments: ' Command_ (string): Command and arguments to run ' RaiseError (boolean): If True, raise an error when an error is encountered. Otherwise, just print an error message and quit ' Timeout (int): Timeout in seconds (Default = 45) ' LogLevel (string): Log level (Default = "error") ' ExePath (string): Path to wrappper exe use (Default = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe") ' RedirectOutput (String or Array(2)): Path to redirect stdout if a non-empty String, or paths to stdout and stderr if an Array(2) 'Returns: ' A command string Dim objFSO: Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If ExePath = "" Then ExePath = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe"
If Not objFSO.FileExists(ExePath) Then Call fRaiseError(53, "TExecHelper", "Standard Utilities Missing: " & ExePath, RaiseError) '53 = "File not found" Error Code End If
'Set default values if not defined If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 If LogLevel = "" Then LogLevel = "error"
Dim strCommand strCommand = Chr(34) & ExePath & Chr(34) strCommand = strCommand & " --timeout " & Timeout strCommand = strCommand & " --loglevel " & LogLevel
Dim valid: valid = False If TypeName(RedirectOutput) = "String" Then If Not RedirectOutput = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput & Chr(34) valid = True ElseIf TypeName(RedirectOutput) = TypeName(Array()) Then If UBound(RedirectOutput) = 1 Then If Not RedirectOutput(0) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput(0) & Chr(34) If Not RedirectOutput(1) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stderr-to """ & RedirectOutput(1) & Chr(34) valid = True End If ElseIf RedirectOutput = False Then valid = True End If
If Not valid Then Call fRaiseError(5, "TExecHelper", _ "RedirectOutput argument to TExecHelper must be a String or a Length-2 Array.", RaiseError) '5 = "Invalid procedure call or argument" Error Code End If
strCommand = strCommand & " -- " & Command_ TExecHelper = strCommand End Function 'TExecHelper '- End file: exec/TExecHelper.vbs '- Begin file: exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs

Class MockTextStream Private text Private stream_read
Public Default Function Init(stream_content) Set Init = Me text = stream_content stream_read = False End Function
Public Property Get ReadAll If Not stream_read Then ReadAll = text stream_read = True Else ReadAll = "" End If End Property End Class
Class MockWshScriptExec Private stdout_: Public Property Get StdOut : Set StdOut = stdout_ : End Property Private stderr_: Public Property Get StdErr : Set StdErr = stderr_ : End Property Private exitcode_: Public Property Get ExitCode : ExitCode = exitcode_ : End Property
Public Default Function Init(strCommand) Set Init = Me Dim stdout_backer: Set stdout_backer=(new StreamBacker)("WScript.StdOut", False, True) Dim stderr_backer: Set stderr_backer=(new StreamBacker)("WScript.StdErr", False, True)
Dim objShell: Set objShell = CreateObject("Wscript.Shell") Dim realWshScriptExec: Set realWshScriptExec = objShell.Exec(strCommand) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK
Do While realWshScriptExec.Status = 0 stdout_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdOut) stderr_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdErr) Loop stdout_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdOut) stderr_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdErr) stdout_backer.Stream.Position = 0 stderr_backer.Stream.Position = 0
Set stdout_ = (new MockTextStream)(stdout_backer.Stream.ReadText) Set stderr_ = (new MockTextStream)(stderr_backer.Stream.ReadText) exitcode_ = RealWshScriptExec.ExitCode End Function End Class '- End file: exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs '- Begin file: exec/StreamBacker.vbs ' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/StreamBacker.vbs
Class StreamBacker Private stream_ Private stdStream_ Public Property Get HasStdStream : HasStdStream=Not stdStream_ Is Nothing : End Property Public Property Get HasSelfStream : HasSelfStream=Not stream_ Is Nothing : End Property Public Property Get Stream : Set Stream=stream_ : End Property
Public Default Function Init(strName, bRedirectIfPossible, bStoreIfNotRedirected) Set Init=Me
Set stdStream_ = Nothing
If bRedirectIfPossible Then On Error Resume Next Set stdStream_=Eval(strName) If Err.Number<>0 Then Set stdStream_ = Nothing Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 End If
Set stream_=Nothing If Not HasStdStream And bStoreIfNotRedirected Then Set stream_ = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream") stream_.Charset="UTF-8" stream_.Open End If End Function
Sub Class_Terminate Set stream_ = Nothing Set stdStream_ = Nothing End Sub
Sub drainFrom(s) Do While Not s.AtEndOfStream Write s.Read(1024) Loop End Sub
Sub Write(s) If HasStdStream Then stdStream_.Write s ElseIf HasSelfStream Then stream_.WriteText s End If End Sub
End Class '- End file: exec/StreamBacker.vbs

Option Explicit
'INCLUDE=utils/settings/GetClientDir.vbs 'INCLUDE=i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir.vbs 'INCLUDE=index/CheckEPIArgSupport.vbs 'INCLUDE=exec/TaniumExec.vbs
Dim strTaniumEpiDir,fso,strExeName,strDestFilePath,objShell,execed,strLimit,strUrlArg,strOptionalArg,strExecWrapper Dim strDirectoryPathIn,strFileNameIn,strSizeIn,strHashIn,strHashSHA1In,strHashSHA256In,strMagicNumberIn,strLimitIn Dim strDirectoryPath,strFileName,strSize,strHash,strHashSHA1,strHashSHA256,strMagicNumber Dim strLookBkHrsIn,strExcludeTCEntries,blnExcludeTCEntries Dim bTreatAsRegex,strTreatAsRegex
strTaniumEpiDir = GetClientDir() & "Tools\EPI\" strExeName = "TaniumEndpointIndex.exe" strExecWrapper = strTaniumEpiDir & "TaniumExecWrapper.exe"
Set fso = WScript.CreateObject("Scripting.Filesystemobject") Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") strDestFilePath = strTaniumEpiDir & strExeName
'default limit strLimit="10"
bTreatAsRegex = False strTreatAsRegex = UTF8Decode("||treatInputAsRegex||") If Trim(strTreatAsRegex) = "1" Then bTreatAsRegex = CheckEPIRegexSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath) End If strDirectoryPathIn = UTF8Decode("||directoryPath||") strFileNameIn = UTF8Decode("||fileName||") strSizeIn = UTF8Decode("||fileSize||") strHashIn = UTF8Decode("||fileMD5Hash||") strHashSHA1In = UTF8Decode("||fileSHA1Hash||") strHashSHA256In = UTF8Decode("||fileSHA256Hash||") strMagicNumberIn = UTF8Decode("||magicNumber||") strLimitIn = UTF8Decode("||limit||") strLookBkHrsIn = UTF8Decode("||lookBkHrs||") strExcludeTCEntries = UTF8Decode("||excludeTCEntries||")
strDirectoryPath = GenerateValidQueryInput(strDirectoryPathIn,"*") strFileName = GenerateValidQueryInput(strFileNameIn,"*") strSize = GenerateValidQueryInput(strSizeIn,"*") strHash = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashIn,"*") strHashSHA1 = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashSHA1In,"*") strHashSHA256 = GenerateValidQueryInput(strHashSHA256In,"*") strMagicNumber = GenerateValidQueryInput(strMagicNumberIn,"*") strLimit = GenerateValidQueryInput(strLimitIn,strLimit)
If Trim(strExcludeTCEntries) = "0" Then blnExcludeTCEntries = false Else blnExcludeTCEntries = true End If
strUrlArg=" --url-encode-output" strOptionalArg="" If CheckEPIArgSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath, strUrlArg)Then strOptionalArg=strUrlArg End If execed=ExeEPI(fso,objShell, strDestFilePath, strDirectoryPath, strFileName, strSize, strHash, strMagicNumber, strLimit, strOptionalArg)
Function UnixDate(dtmDate) ' converts a date value to seconds since Unix epoch UnixDate = DateDiff("s", "01/01/1970 00:00:00", dtmDate) End Function
Function ExeEPI(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath,ByVal strDirectoryPath, ByVal strFileName,ByVal strSize,ByVal strHash,ByVal strMagicNumber,ByVal strLimit,ByVal strOptionalArg) ExeEPI=False If (fso.FileExists(strDestFilePath))Then Dim oExec,strCmd,strOutput,strSelect,strParams,intUnixTimeNow,intUnixTimeStart,intLookBkHrs,strSQLiteOR
intLookBkHrs = -1 intUnixTimeNow = UnixDate(Now)
'convert input string to integer On Error Resume Next intLookBkHrs = CInt(strLookBkHrsIn) On Error Goto 0
If intLookBkHrs < 0 Then WScript.Echo ("Look back hours value is not valid.") WScript.Quit End If
If intLookBkHrs > 168 Then WScript.Echo ("Look back hours exceeds maximum allowed.") WScript.Quit Else intUnixTimeStart = intUnixTimeNow - (intLookBkHrs * 3600) End If
strSQLiteOR = "||" strSelect = "SELECT Path " & strSQLiteOR & "'\'" & strSQLiteOR & "Name, MD5, SHA1, SHA256 FROM vFiles WHERE" strSelect = strSelect & " FileId > 0" Call RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir(strDirectoryPath) If bTreatAsRegex Then ' Special prefix means we'll be using regular expressions, and therefore ' may need the '|' character inside actual parameter values. ' Use double pipes as the separator. strParams="@regex" Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Name",strFileName,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"Size",strSize,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"MD5",strHash,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"SHA1",strHashSHA1,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"SHA256",strHashSHA256,"||") Call AppendWhereRegex(strSelect,strParams,"MagicNumber",strMagicNumber,"||") Call AppendTimeSliceRegex(strSelect,strParams,intUnixTimeStart,"||") Else If IsSpecialDirectoryGlob(strDirectoryPath) Then Call AppendSpecialDirectoryGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath) Else Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Path",strDirectoryPath) End If Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Name",strFileName) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"Size",strSize) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"MD5",strHash) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"SHA1",strHashSHA1) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"SHA256",strHashSHA256) Call AppendWhereGlob(strSelect,strParams,"MagicNumber",strMagicNumber) Call AppendTimeSlice(strSelect,strParams,intUnixTimeStart) End If
If blnExcludeTCEntries Then Dim strTCDir: strTCDir = GetClientDir() If Right(strTCDir, 1) = "\" Then strTCDir = Left(strTCDir, Len(strTCDir) - 1) End If strSelect = strSelect & " AND Path NOT LIKE '%"& strTCDir &"%'" End If
strSelect = strSelect & " LIMIT " & strLimit
strCmd=Chr(34)& strDestFilePath &Chr(34)& strOptionalArg & " -psescape " &Chr(34)& "^" &Chr(34)& " -psprep " &Chr(34)& strSelect &Chr(34)& " -psparams " &Chr(34)& strParams &Chr(34)
Set oExec = TaniumExec(strCmd, False, 55, "", strExecWrapper, "")
strOutput = strOutput & oExec.StdOut.ReadAll If (strOptionalArg=strUrlArg)Then WScript.Echo UTF8Decode(strOutput) Else WScript.Echo strOutput End If ExeEPI=True Else WScript.Echo "Error: Could not find Tanium Endpoint Index" End If End Function '------------ INCLUDES below ----- '- Begin file: utils/settings/GetClientDir.vbs ' Returns the directory of the client ' Note: GetClientDir always returns ending with a \ ' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=utils/settings/GetClientDir.vbs
Function GetClientDir() Dim strResult
strResult = GetEnvironmentValue("TANIUM_CLIENT_ROOT")
If IsNull(strResult) Then Dim objSh strResult = "" Set objSh = CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
On Error Resume Next If strResult="" Then strResult=Eval("objSh.RegRead(""HKLM\Software\Tanium\Tanium Client\Path"")") : Err.Clear If strResult="" Then strResult=Eval("objSh.RegRead(""HKLM\Software\Wow6432Node\Tanium\Tanium Client\Path"")") : Err.Clear If strResult="" Then Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 End If
If strResult="" Then Call fRaiseError(5, "GetClientDir", _ "TSE-Error:Can not locate client directory", False)
If Right(strResult, 1) <> "\" Then strResult = strResult & "\"
GetClientDir = strResult End Function '- End file: utils/settings/GetClientDir.vbs '- Begin file: utils/RaiseError.vbs ' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=utils/RaiseError.vbs
Function fRaiseError(errCode, errSource, errorMsg, RaiseError) If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(errCode, errSource, errorMsg) Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End Function '- End file: utils/RaiseError.vbs '- Begin file: utils/os/GetEnvironmentValue.vbs ' Returns the passed in environment variable value. ' Returns either the value as set in the environment, or Null if not set
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=utils/os/GetEnvironmentValue.vbs
Function GetEnvironmentValue(strName) Dim objShell, strSub, strResult Set objShell = CreateObject("WScript.Shell") strSub = "%" & strName & "%" strResult = objShell.ExpandEnvironmentStrings(strSub)
If strResult = strSub Then GetEnvironmentValue = Null Else GetEnvironmentValue = strResult End If End Function ' GetEnvironmentValue '- End file: utils/os/GetEnvironmentValue.vbs '- Begin file: i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs '======================================== ' UTF8Decode '======================================== ' Used to convert the UTF-8 style parameters passed from ' the server to sensors in sensor parameters. ' This function should be used to safely pass non english input to sensors.
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs
Function UTF8Decode(str) Dim arraylist(), strLen, i, sT, val, depth, sR Dim arraysize arraysize = 0 strLen = Len(str) for i = 1 to strLen sT = mid(str, i, 1) if sT = "%" then if i + 2 <= strLen then Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = cbyte("&H" & mid(str, i + 1, 2)) arraysize = arraysize + 1 i = i + 2 end if else Redim Preserve arraylist(arraysize + 1) arraylist(arraysize) = asc(sT) arraysize = arraysize + 1 end if next depth = 0 for i = 0 to arraysize - 1 Dim mybyte mybyte = arraylist(i) if mybyte and &h80 then if (mybyte and &h40) = 0 then if depth = 0 then Err.Raise 5 end if val = val * 2 ^ 6 + (mybyte and &h3f) depth = depth - 1 if depth = 0 then sR = sR & chrw(val) val = 0 end if elseif (mybyte and &h20) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h1f depth = 1 elseif (mybyte and &h10) = 0 then if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 val = mybyte and &h0f depth = 2 else Err.Raise 5 end if else if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 sR = sR & chrw(mybyte) end if next if depth > 0 then Err.Raise 5 UTF8Decode = sR End Function '- End file: i18n/UTF8Decode.vbs '- Begin file: index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs Sub AppendWhereGlob(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal) If (StrComp("*", columnVal) <> 0) Then strSelect = strSelect & " AND " & columnName & " LIKE ?" If Len(strParams) <> 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If strParams = strParams + GlobToLike(columnVal) End If End Sub
Sub AppendWhereRegex(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal, ByVal delimVal) If Len(columnVal) > 0 Then If (StrComp("*", columnVal) <> 0) Then If (StrComp(".*", columnVal) <> 0) Then strSelect = strSelect & " AND " & columnName & " REGEXP ?" strParams = strParams + delimVal strParams = strParams + Replace(columnVal, "^", "^^") End If End If End If End Sub
Sub AppendSpecialDirectoryGlob(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnName, ByVal columnVal) ' Strip off the trailing "\*" from the columnVal Dim bareDirectoryVal bareDirectoryVal = Left(columnVal, Len(columnVal) - 2) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (" & columnName & " = ? OR " & columnName & " LIKE ?)" If Len(strParams) > 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If ' Add two parameter values, one for 'bare' directory path, and one with ' the trailing "slash-star" wildcard strParams = strParams & bareDirectoryVal & "|" strParams = strParams + GlobToLike(columnVal) End Sub
Sub AppendTimeSlice(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnVal) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" If Len(strParams) <> 0 Then strParams = strParams + "|" End If strParams = strParams + CStr(columnVal) + "|" + CStr(columnVal) End Sub
Sub AppendTimeSliceRegex(ByRef strSelect, ByRef strParams, ByVal columnVal, ByVal delimVal) strSelect = strSelect & " AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" strParams = strParams + delimVal + CStr(columnVal) + delimVal + CStr(columnVal) End Sub
Function IsSpecialDirectoryGlob(ByVal strDirectoryParam) ' Regex search to see if directory parameter is something like ' C:\Users\* ' Where a trailing slash is followed by the star wildcard Dim specialRx Set specialRx = New RegExp specialRx.Global = True specialRx.IgnoreCase = True specialRx.Pattern = "^([A-Z]:\\[^\*\?]+)\\\*$" IsSpecialDirectoryGlob = specialRx.Test(strDirectoryParam) End Function
Function GlobToLike(byVal strGlob) GlobToLike = strGlob GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "^", "^^") GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "*", "^%") GlobToLike = Replace(GlobToLike, "?", "_") End Function '- End file: index/AppendWhereGlob.vbs '- Begin file: index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs Function GenerateValidQueryInput(ByVal strIn, ByVal strDefaultValue) If Len(strIn) = 0 Then If Len(strDefaultValue) = 0 Then GenerateValidQueryInput="*" Else GenerateValidQueryInput=strDefaultValue End If Else GenerateValidQueryInput = strIn End If End Function
Function GenerateValidRegexInput(ByVal strIn, ByVal strDefaultValue) If Len(strIn) = 0 Then If Len(strDefaultValue) = 0 Then GenerateValidRegexInput=".+" Else GenerateValidRegexInput=strDefaultValue End If Else GenerateValidRegexInput = strIn End If End Function '- End file: index/GenerateValidQueryInput.vbs '- Begin file: index/RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir.vbs Sub RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir(ByRef strDirectoryPath) Dim strDirectoryPathLen
strDirectoryPathLen = Len(strDirectoryPath) If strDirectoryPathLen > 1 Then If Right(strDirectoryPath, 1) = "\" Then strDirectoryPath = Left(strDirectoryPath, Len(strDirectoryPath)-1) End If End If End Sub '- End file: index/RemoveTrailingBackslashFromDir.vbs '- Begin file: index/CheckEPIArgSupport.vbs Function CheckEPIArgSupport(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath, ByVal strOptionalArg) CheckEPIArgSupport=False If (fso.FileExists(strDestFilePath))Then Dim strCmd,strErrorCode
strCmd=Chr(34)&strDestFilePath&Chr(34)& strOptionalArg & " -v" strErrorCode = objShell.Run(strCmd,0,True) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK If (strErrorCode="0")Then CheckEPIArgSupport=True End If End If End Function
Function CheckEPIRegexSupport(ByRef fso, ByRef objShell, ByVal strDestFilePath) CheckEPIRegexSupport=CheckEPIArgSupport(fso, objShell, strDestFilePath, "--regex-search") End Function '- End file: index/CheckEPIArgSupport.vbs '- Begin file: exec/TaniumExec.vbs
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/TaniumExec.vbs
Function TaniumExec(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) 'Wraps and executes the Command_ via ExePath using Wscript.Shell.Exec(strCommand) ' 'Arguments: ' Command_ (string): Command and arguments to run ' RaiseError (boolean): If True, raise an error when an error is encountered. Otherwise, just print an error message and quit ' Timeout (int): Timeout in seconds (Default = 45) ' LogLevel (string): Log level (Default = "error") ' ExePath (string): Path to wrappper exe use (Default = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe") ' RedirectOutput (String or Array(2)): Path to redirect stdout if a non-empty String, or paths to stdout and stderr if an Array(2) 'Returns: ' Execution results object If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 Dim strCommand: strCommand = TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) Set TaniumExec = (new MockWshScriptExec)(strCommand)
' ExitCode = 10 is encountered when the timeout is reaching, causing TaniumExecWrapper to kill the process If TaniumExec.ExitCode = 10 Then Dim errorMsg: errorMsg = "Timeout limit of " & Timeout & " second(s) reached and the process was killed: " & strCommand If RaiseError Then On Error Resume Next Call Err.Raise(6, "TaniumExec", errorMsg) '6 = "Overflow" Error Code Exit Function Else WScript.Echo errorMsg Wscript.Quit End If End If End Function 'TaniumExec '- End file: exec/TaniumExec.vbs '- Begin file: exec/TExecHelper.vbs
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/TExecHelper.vbs
Function TExecHelper(Command_, RaiseError, Timeout, LogLevel, ExePath, RedirectOutput) 'Builds a command string intended to be executed via Wscript.Shell.Exec or Wscript.Shell.Run ' 'Arguments: ' Command_ (string): Command and arguments to run ' RaiseError (boolean): If True, raise an error when an error is encountered. Otherwise, just print an error message and quit ' Timeout (int): Timeout in seconds (Default = 45) ' LogLevel (string): Log level (Default = "error") ' ExePath (string): Path to wrappper exe use (Default = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe") ' RedirectOutput (String or Array(2)): Path to redirect stdout if a non-empty String, or paths to stdout and stderr if an Array(2) 'Returns: ' A command string Dim objFSO: Set objFSO = CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
If ExePath = "" Then ExePath = GetClientDir() & "Tools\StdUtils\TaniumExecWrapper.exe"
If Not objFSO.FileExists(ExePath) Then Call fRaiseError(53, "TExecHelper", "Standard Utilities Missing: " & ExePath, RaiseError) '53 = "File not found" Error Code End If
'Set default values if not defined If Timeout = "" Then Timeout = 45 If LogLevel = "" Then LogLevel = "error"
Dim strCommand strCommand = Chr(34) & ExePath & Chr(34) strCommand = strCommand & " --timeout " & Timeout strCommand = strCommand & " --loglevel " & LogLevel
Dim valid: valid = False If TypeName(RedirectOutput) = "String" Then If Not RedirectOutput = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput & Chr(34) valid = True ElseIf TypeName(RedirectOutput) = TypeName(Array()) Then If UBound(RedirectOutput) = 1 Then If Not RedirectOutput(0) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stdout-to """ & RedirectOutput(0) & Chr(34) If Not RedirectOutput(1) = "" Then strCommand = strCommand & " --stderr-to """ & RedirectOutput(1) & Chr(34) valid = True End If ElseIf RedirectOutput = False Then valid = True End If
If Not valid Then Call fRaiseError(5, "TExecHelper", _ "RedirectOutput argument to TExecHelper must be a String or a Length-2 Array.", RaiseError) '5 = "Invalid procedure call or argument" Error Code End If
strCommand = strCommand & " -- " & Command_ TExecHelper = strCommand End Function 'TExecHelper '- End file: exec/TExecHelper.vbs '- Begin file: exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs
' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs
Class MockTextStream Private text Private stream_read
Public Default Function Init(stream_content) Set Init = Me text = stream_content stream_read = False End Function
Public Property Get ReadAll If Not stream_read Then ReadAll = text stream_read = True Else ReadAll = "" End If End Property End Class
Class MockWshScriptExec Private stdout_: Public Property Get StdOut : Set StdOut = stdout_ : End Property Private stderr_: Public Property Get StdErr : Set StdErr = stderr_ : End Property Private exitcode_: Public Property Get ExitCode : ExitCode = exitcode_ : End Property
Public Default Function Init(strCommand) Set Init = Me Dim stdout_backer: Set stdout_backer=(new StreamBacker)("WScript.StdOut", False, True) Dim stderr_backer: Set stderr_backer=(new StreamBacker)("WScript.StdErr", False, True)
Dim objShell: Set objShell = CreateObject("Wscript.Shell") Dim realWshScriptExec: Set realWshScriptExec = objShell.Exec(strCommand) '' @SKIP_VBS_CHECK
Do While realWshScriptExec.Status = 0 stdout_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdOut) stderr_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdErr) Loop stdout_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdOut) stderr_backer.drainFrom(realWshScriptExec.StdErr) stdout_backer.Stream.Position = 0 stderr_backer.Stream.Position = 0
Set stdout_ = (new MockTextStream)(stdout_backer.Stream.ReadText) Set stderr_ = (new MockTextStream)(stderr_backer.Stream.ReadText) exitcode_ = RealWshScriptExec.ExitCode End Function End Class '- End file: exec/MockWshScriptExec.vbs '- Begin file: exec/StreamBacker.vbs ' To include this file, copy/paste: INCLUDE=exec/StreamBacker.vbs
Class StreamBacker Private stream_ Private stdStream_ Public Property Get HasStdStream : HasStdStream=Not stdStream_ Is Nothing : End Property Public Property Get HasSelfStream : HasSelfStream=Not stream_ Is Nothing : End Property Public Property Get Stream : Set Stream=stream_ : End Property
Public Default Function Init(strName, bRedirectIfPossible, bStoreIfNotRedirected) Set Init=Me
Set stdStream_ = Nothing
If bRedirectIfPossible Then On Error Resume Next Set stdStream_=Eval(strName) If Err.Number<>0 Then Set stdStream_ = Nothing Err.Clear On Error Goto 0 End If
Set stream_=Nothing If Not HasStdStream And bStoreIfNotRedirected Then Set stream_ = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream") stream_.Charset="UTF-8" stream_.Open End If End Function
Sub Class_Terminate Set stream_ = Nothing Set stdStream_ = Nothing End Sub
Sub drainFrom(s) Do While Not s.AtEndOfStream Write s.Read(1024) Loop End Sub
Sub Write(s) If HasStdStream Then stdStream_.Write s ElseIf HasSelfStream Then stream_.WriteText s End If End Sub
End Class '- End file: exec/StreamBacker.vbs

#!/bin/bash #------------ INCLUDES START - Do not edit between this line and INCLUDE ENDS ----- percent_decode() { local data=$(echo "$1" | sed 's/%/\\\x/g') command printf '%b' "$data" } GenerateValidQueryInput() { local strIn="$1" local strDefaultValue="$2" if [ "$strIn" = "" ] || [ "`echo "$strIn" | egrep -v '^\|\|'`" = "" ]; then if [ "$strDefaultValue" = "" ]; then echo \* else echo "$strDefaultValue" fi else echo "$strIn" | sed -e 's/\\$//' fi } GenerateValidRegexInput() { local strIn="$1" local strDefaultValue="$2" if [ "$strIn" = "" ] || [ "$strIn" = "*" ] || [ "`echo "$strIn" | egrep -v '^\|\|'`" = "" ]; then if [ "$strDefaultValue" = "" ]; then echo \.\+ else echo "$strDefaultValue" fi else echo "$strIn" fi } CheckEPIArgSupport() { local EPI="$1" local strOptionalArg="$2" if [ -x "$EPI" ]; then ${EPI} ${strOptionalArg} -v 1>/dev/null 2>&1 if [ $? = 0 ]; then echo "True" else echo "False" fi fi } CheckEPIRegexSupport() { local EPI="$1" regexFlagSupported=$( CheckEPIArgSupport "${EPI}" "--regex-search" ) echo $regexFlagSupported } GlobToLike() { local strGlob="$1" strGlob=$(echo "$strGlob" | sed 's/\?/\_/g') strGlob=$(echo "$strGlob" | sed 's/\*/\%/g') echo "$strGlob" } AppendWhereLike() { local columnName=$1 local columnVal=$2 if ! [ "$columnVal" = "*" ]; then strSelect="${strSelect} AND ${columnName} LIKE ?" if ! [ "$strParams" = "" ]; then strParams="${strParams}|" fi local param=`GlobToLike "$columnVal"` strParams="${strParams}${param}" fi } AppendWhereGlob() { local columnName=$1 local columnVal=$2 if ! [ "$columnVal" = "*" ]; then strSelect="${strSelect} AND ${columnName} GLOB ?" if ! [ "$strParams" = "" ]; then strParams="${strParams}|" fi strParams="${strParams}${columnVal}" fi } IsEverythingRegex() { local searchVal="$1" local retVal="False" if [ "$searchVal" = "" ] || [ "$searchVal" = "*" ] || [ "$searchVal" = ".*" ]; then retVal="True" fi echo "$retVal" } AppendWhereRegex() { local colName="$1" local colVal="$2" local colDelim="$3" isEverything=$( IsEverythingRegex "$colVal" ) if [ "$isEverything" = "False" ]; then strSelect="${strSelect} AND $colName REGEXP ?" strParams="${strParams}${colDelim}${colVal}" fi } AppendTimeSlice() { local columnVal=$1 strSelect="${strSelect} AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" if ! [ "$strParams" = "" ]; then strParams="${strParams}|" fi strParams="${strParams}${columnVal}|${columnVal}" } AppendTimeSliceRegex() { local colVal=$1 local colDelim="$2" strSelect="${strSelect} AND (Created > ? OR Modified > ?)" strParams="${strParams}${colDelim}${colVal}${colDelim}${colVal}" } AppendSpecialSlashStarGlob() { local columnName=$1 local columnVal=$2 strSelect="${strSelect} AND (${columnName} = ? OR ${columnName} GLOB ?)" if ! [ "$strParams" = "" ]; then strParams="${strParams}|" fi strParams="${strParams}${columnVal}|${columnVal}/*" } IsSpecialSlashStarGlob() { local searchStr='^(/[^\*\?]+)/\*$' if [[ "$1" =~ $searchStr ]]; then echo "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" else echo "" fi } SchemaItemExists () { local EPI=$1 local viewName=$2 local viewExists='FALSE' if [ -x "$EPI" ]; then sqlQuery="SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sqlite_master WHERE name LIKE ?1) THEN 'TRUE' ELSE 'FALSE' END" viewExists=`$EPI -psprep "$sqlQuery" -psparams "$viewName"` fi echo "$viewExists" } FileQueryViewName () { local EPI="$1" local hasNewView=`SchemaItemExists "$EPI" "vFilesSimplePOSIX"` if [ "$hasNewView" = "TRUE" ]; then echo "vFilesSimplePOSIX" else echo "vFiles" fi } FileQueryViewWithPermissionsName () { local EPI="$1" local hasNewView=`SchemaItemExists "$EPI" "vFilesPOSIX"` if [ "$hasNewView" = "TRUE" ]; then echo "vFilesPOSIX" else echo "vFiles" fi } # The comment below prevents problems with stripping the $# incorrectly #DONOTCOMMENTPROCESSNEXTLINE if [ $# -eq 0 ]; then if [ "${__max_exec_time_in_sec}" = "" ]; then __max_exec_time_in_sec=55 fi if [ "${__exec_shell}" = "" ]; then __exec_shell=bash fi kernelName=`uname -s` if [ "${kernelName}" = "Linux" ]; then osName="Linux" elif [ "${kernelName}" = "Darwin" ]; then osName="Mac" else echo "Couldn't determine OS name" exit 0 fi if ! [ -e Tools/EPI/TaniumExecWrapper ]; then echo "Error: TaniumExecWrapper Not found. Please first run the package:" \ "\"Distribute Tanium Endpoint Index Tools for ${osName}\"" if [ "$TEW_NOT_FOUND_ADDITIONAL_MESSAGE" != "" ]; then echo "$TEW_NOT_FOUND_ADDITIONAL_MESSAGE" fi exit 0 fi ./Tools/EPI/TaniumExecWrapper --timeout \ ${__max_exec_time_in_sec} -- ${__exec_shell} $0 "ARBITRARY_ARG" if [ $? -eq 3 ]; then echo "Timeout limit of ${__max_exec_time_in_sec}" \ "second(s) reached and so the process was killed" fi exit 0 fi #------------ INCLUDES END - Do not edit above this line and INCLUDE STARTS ----- taniumpath=$(pwd) Toolspath="${taniumpath}/Tools" EPIpath="${Toolspath}/EPI" EPI="${EPIpath}/TaniumEndpointIndex" if ! [ -d "$taniumpath" ]; then echo "Error: $taniumpath does not exist on the filesystem" exit fi if ! [ -x "$EPI" ]; then echo "Error: Could not find Tanium Endpoint Index" exit fi queryViewName=`FileQueryViewName "$EPI"` strLimit=10 bUseRegex="False" bTreatAsRegEx=`percent_decode "||treatInputAsRegex||"` strDirectoryPathIn=`percent_decode "||directoryPath||"` strFileNameIn=`percent_decode "||fileName||"` strSizeIn=`percent_decode "||fileSize||"` strHashIn=`percent_decode "||fileMD5Hash||"` strHashSHA1In=`percent_decode "||fileSHA1Hash||"` strHashSHA256In=`percent_decode "||fileSHA256Hash||"` strMagicNumberIn=`percent_decode "||magicNumber||"` strLimitIn=`percent_decode "||limit||"` strLookBkHrs=`percent_decode "||lookBkHrs||"` blnExcludeTCEntries=`percent_decode "||excludeTCEntries||"` if [ "$bTreatAsRegEx" = "1" ]; then bUseRegex=$( CheckEPIRegexSupport "${EPI}" ) fi strDirectoryPath=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strDirectoryPathIn" "*"` strFileName=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strFileNameIn" "*"` strSize=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strSizeIn" "*"` strHash=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strHashIn" "*"` strHashSHA1=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strHashSHA1In" "*"` strHashSHA256=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strHashSHA256In" "*"` strMagicNumber=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strMagicNumberIn" "*"` strLimit=`GenerateValidQueryInput "$strLimitIn" $strLimit` intUnixTimeNow=$(date +%s) intLookBkHrs=`expr $strLookBkHrs + 0 2>/dev/null` if [ $? != 0 ]; then intLookBkHrs=-1 fi if [ $intLookBkHrs -lt 0 ]; then echo "Look back hours value is not valid." exit fi if [ $intLookBkHrs -gt 168 ]; then echo "Look back hours exceeds maximum allowed." exit else intUnixTimeStart=$(($intUnixTimeNow - $(($intLookBkHrs * 3600)))) fi strSQLiteOR="||" strSelect="SELECT rtrim(Path, '/') ${strSQLiteOR} '/' ${strSQLiteOR} Name, MD5, SHA1, SHA256 FROM ${queryViewName} WHERE FileId > 0" strParams="" lastChar=`echo "$strDirectoryPath" | sed -e 's/.*\(.\)$/\1/'` if [ "$lastChar" = '/' ]; then #DONOTCOMMENTPROCESSNEXTLINE lastCharPos=$((${#strDirectoryPath}-1)) if [ $lastCharPos -gt 0 ]; then strDirectoryPath="`echo "$strDirectoryPath" | head -c $lastCharPos`" fi fi if [ "$bUseRegex" = "True" ]; then rxDelim='||' strParams='@regex' AppendWhereRegex "Path" "$strDirectoryPath" "$rxDelim" AppendWhereRegex "Name" "$strFileName" "$rxDelim" AppendWhereRegex "Size" "$strSize" "$rxDelim" AppendWhereRegex "MD5" "$strHash" "$rxDelim" AppendWhereRegex "SHA1" "$strHashSHA1" "$rxDelim" AppendWhereRegex "SHA256" "$strHashSHA256" "$rxDelim" AppendWhereRegex "MagicNumber" "$strMagicNumber" "$rxDelim" AppendTimeSliceRegex $intUnixTimeStart "$rxDelim" else specialPathSearch=`IsSpecialSlashStarGlob "${strDirectoryPath}"` if [ -z $specialPathSearch ]; then AppendWhereGlob "Path" "$strDirectoryPath" else AppendSpecialSlashStarGlob "Path" "$specialPathSearch" fi AppendWhereGlob "Name" "$strFileName" AppendWhereLike "Size" "$strSize" AppendWhereLike "MD5" "$strHash" AppendWhereLike "SHA1" "$strHashSHA1" AppendWhereLike "SHA256" "$strHashSHA256" AppendWhereLike "MagicNumber" "$strMagicNumber" AppendTimeSlice $intUnixTimeStart fi if [ "$blnExcludeTCEntries" = "1" ]; then strSelect="${strSelect} AND Path NOT LIKE '${taniumpath}%'" fi strSelect="${strSelect} LIMIT ${strLimit}" strCmd=(${EPI} -psprep "${strSelect}" -psparams "${strParams}") exec "${strCmd[@]}" | while read line; do echo $line done

meta_data_item.name: TANIUMCONTENT_description.en
meta_data_item.value: The Index Query File Hash Recently Changed sensor returns filenames and hashes for files that have been created or modified within a given number of hours. For example, you can search for binary files that have been created or modified under C:\Windows\System32\ in the previous 8 hours. By searching for files with a File Magic Number glob of 4D5A*, you can focus your search on Windows PE binary files (EXEs and DLLs). The Index Query File Hash Recently Changed sensor supports both wildcards and regular expressions in parameters with the exception of the Maximum Number of Rows and Lookback Hours parameters. Supported wildcard syntax includes the * character to match any number of characters and the ? character to match one character. For example, you can use *pad.exe to search for either notepad.exe or wordpad.exe. To use regular expressions in parameter values, make sure the Use Regular Expressions check box is selected. You can use regular expressions to search for more complex patterns and to further constrain the scope of the search. For example, ^(if|ip)config(\.exe)?$ matches ifconfig, ipconfig, ifconfig.exe, and ipconfig.exe.
